# ue-capture-toolset

> Pure core and Unreal adapter for reproducible captures with JSON sidecars, bug evidence and Markdown contact sheets. Python package `trysac-ue-capture-toolset`, import name `ue_capture_toolset`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example, public API
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the package and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run the tests
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Agent usage](docs/AGENT_USAGE.md): Unreal MCP toolset `CaptureTools`, call_tool examples
